study type: Analysis of seven waves of the Indonesia Demographic and Health Survey
cohort: Women who gave birth in Indonesia between 1987 and 2017
finding: The study found increasing trends in cesarean section rates in Indonesia over 30 years, with widening absolute inequalities across different sociodemographic groups, while relative inequalities remained stable.
mod_finding: This study examined trends in cesarean section use in Indonesia, finding that rates are increasing but inequalities in who receives them persist.
